snippet.title: Citta Nuova with WipEout HD's "physics..."
snippet.description:
Someone made a mod for WipEout Pure and Pulse that basically replaces the ship stats in the games with the ship stats from WipEout HD, and it's really impressive imo, I had a lot of fun with it. Thanks to this mod, I decided to combine this mod with the experimental version of WipEout Pulse from the "WipEout: Portable Collection" mod by NR74W, (AKA WipEout Pulse Future Edition) so that I could play with the mod on tracks from WipEout Pure that never made it into WipEout HD. Most importantly, tracks like Citta Nuova. Oh boy...

Now I see why this track never made it into WipEout HD


Wipeout Pure and Pulse Ships with Wipeout HD Stats mod by Smite Attractant: 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EBQ8zApI6-Q&t=53s

Music:
Elite Force, Bassbin Twins, Stanton Warriors - Rhythm Rocks the Blue (Album: REVAMPED by Elite Force)
